items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: I'm going to stick on the job where I'm working at. I'm working with Ricard.

ctx.x: That's Fats, Fats Houston? No, Celestine. Celestine.

Yeah, Papa. So he said, I want to get some other fellas to work with. So he thought he was all tired of it, Mr. Steve Leonard. Mr. Steve Leonard would do anything he said he would do. So Houston said, what do you want a week? So Papa Celestine said, I want $300 a week. That time he was getting $70. He said, I want $300 a week for myself. So I told him, I said, well, Papa, you know, you don't want to work there. He said, well, you're right, Billy. You're right. I don't want to work there. He said, if you give me…
